insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3Cr (by plan). Family First: Base Individual SI 1L to 15L + Floater SI as per formula (by plan).

great.name: Restore Benefit (Refill) – up to 100% of Base Sum Insured (same & different illness)
great.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: After your Base SI (and Loyalty additions, if any) is used up, the policy can refill up to 100% of Base SI for further eligible hospital claims in the same policy year.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer – Re-fill amount activates after base is exhausted
great.quote: If the Base Sum Insured and increased Sum Insured under Loyalty Additions... has been partially or completely exhausted due to claims... then We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: This is an in-built extra cover that becomes available once the main cover (and loyalty additions) gets exhausted, improving protection against multiple hospitalizations.

great.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period – 24 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.explanation: PED coverage starts after 24 months of continuous coverage (subject to declaration and acceptance), which is better than many 36-month policies.

great.name: Specified disease/procedure waiting period – 12 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.reference: Section 5.1.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02
great.explanation: Common listed surgeries/conditions (cataract, hernia, piles, etc.) are covered after 12 months, which is better than the common 24-month waiting period.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization cover – 90 days
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 90 days before hospitalization (when related to the same hospitalization).

great.name: Post-hospitalization cover – 180 days
great.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

good.name: Initial waiting period – 30 days (illness)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Standard industry practice: illnesses are covered after 30 days; accidents are covered from day 1.

good.name: Room rent – Covered up to Sum Insured (except suite or above) (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Effectively ‘no fixed daily room rent cap’ for standard rooms (suite/above excluded). Note: Family First variant has rupee caps/options for room rent.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with minimum 3 days condition)
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization... The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.explanation: Home hospitalization is covered, but only if it continues for at least 3 consecutive days.

good.name: Modern treatments covered but with robotic surgery sub-limit
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (robotic special condition)
good.explanation: Modern treatments are included, but robotic surgeries have a limit (₹1 lakh) except certain listed robotic surgeries.

good.name: Renewal bonus (Loyalty Additions / Cumulative Bonus) – 10% per year up to 100% of Base SI (resets not stated as zero)
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions... by increasing the Sum Insured... by 10% of the Base Sum Insured... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 10% of Base SI at renewal/continuation, up to 100% of Base SI. The document does not state a typical NCB ‘reset to zero on claim’ rule.

bad.name: Consumables not covered (many standard consumables are excluded/out-of-pocket)
bad.quote: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered... List  I – Expenses not covered... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK... 57 NEBULISATION KIT... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Many consumables (e.g., gloves, masks, kits) are not payable, increasing out-of-pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease/condition sub-limits – HIV/AIDS capped at ₹50,000
bad.quote: This benefit is covered up to a limit of Rs. 50,000.
bad.explanation: A hard cap for HIV/AIDS-related hospitalization reduces protection for this condition.

bad.name: Mandatory zone-based co-pay option (if Zone 2 selected) – 20% co-pay in specified locations
bad.quote: If You select Zone 2, then 20% Co-payment will apply for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.explanation: If you choose Zone 2 premium, you bear 20% of admissible claims in listed high-cost locations. This is a meaningful reduction in effective coverage (choice depends on zone selected).

unclear.name: Co-pay (base policy, generally) – not explicitly stated as 0%; depends on Policy Schedule/zone
unclear.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
unclear.reference: Section 6.2.14 Claim Cost Sharing Option / Conditions; also Section 6.2.11 Zonal pricing
unclear.explanation: The wording indicates co-pay can apply but does not state a universal 0% co-pay. Co-pay appears to depend on selections like Zone 2 and/or what is shown in the Policy Schedule—verify your schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
